## Teaching and mentoring

As a Graduate Teaching Assistant at the University of Guelph (September 2022–April 2024), I supported five undergraduate geography courses through laboratories, seminars, student consultations, assessment, and hands-on GIS instruction.

### Teaching approach

My teaching focus is practical: helping students connect environmental questions with data, maps, and clear reasoning. My experience includes explaining GIS workflows, helping students resolve technical problems, and providing detailed feedback on laboratory work.

- **Applied learning:** connect geographic concepts with hands-on analysis and environmental questions.
- **Useful feedback:** explain how work can improve, alongside assessment and grading.
- **Student support:** make room for questions and help students work through technical difficulties.

### Courses supported

<ul class="course-grid"><li><strong>GEOG*1350</strong><span>Earth: Hazards and Global Change</span></li><li><strong>GEOG*2000</strong><span>Geomorphology</span></li><li><strong>GEOG*3000</strong><span>Fluvial Processes</span></li><li><strong>GEOG*2480</strong><span>Mapping and GIS</span></li><li><strong>GEOG*3480</strong><span>GIS and Spatial Analysis</span></li></ul>

### Teaching interests and future development

My teaching interests include GIS and geospatial analysis, environmental modelling, watershed science, agricultural sustainability, and environmental decision support. Remote sensing and GeoAI are developing areas for future teaching.

As I develop my teaching, I aim to use clear instructions, step-by-step practical tasks, constructive feedback, and opportunities for students with different levels of technical experience to ask questions. I welcome opportunities to strengthen this approach through teaching development and mentoring.

## Leadership and science–policy practice

My work at BRAC and ICCCAD included team coordination, proposal development, resource mobilisation, partnerships, and knowledge translation. These experiences inform how I connect research with implementation.
